notes: Engine applicability: in Israel the 1598 cc petrol NQ5 is either the 1.6 T-GDi (180 hp, DCT; the Israeli book also lists a G1.6 T-GDi MHEV variant) or the 1.6 T-GDi hybrid (230 hp, 6AT). The primary Israeli source is the Talcar Hebrew book Sportage_NQ5_2022.pdf, which covers the non-hybrid petrol and diesel engines and contains only the Europe-spec petrol table (15,000 km / 12 months; 24-month/30,000 km column grid). kia-israel.co.il lists no separate 2023 hybrid book. The only Israeli hybrid book is MY2026, whose Europe table matches the petrol book on oil interval, plugs and filters but has different coolant first-change (180,000 km). If the vehicle is the HEV, confirm against the MY2023 hybrid book or the importer. The 'except Europe' tables from ownersmanual.kia.com (en_RG and en_GB, 2023/2024) are the same Kia document (not independent of each other), but they are independent of the Israeli book's Europe table. Hebrew quotes come from pypdf extraction of RTL PDFs; words were re-ordered into reading order without changing words or numbers. The MHSG belt '48 months' and the drive-belt column mapping should be checked visually. Fuel additive (G1.6 T-GDi: 'הוסף כל 15,000 ק"מ או 12 חודשים' in IL; 10,000 km/12 months except Europe) was seen but not recorded as a task (no matching task code). Timing drive: no source retrieved states a timing belt/chain interval for the G1.6 T-GDi (the only timing-belt rows are for the diesel D2.0: inspect 120,000 km, replace 240,000 km), so no timing item is recorded. US-market sources (Firestone, KBB, US dealers) cover the 2.5 L / US hybrid in miles and were not used.
